# Md. Shakibur Rahaman - Strategic Lead & Digital Architect

> Full-Stack Creative Director delivering integrated visual design, web engineering, omnichannel social media marketing, strategic PR, high-performance Google Ads, and live experiential event activations.

## 6 Core Service Pillars
1. **Graphics & Visual Identity**: Visual identity systems, logo marks, UI/UX interface design, luxury packaging, editorial print, and high-impact marketing collateral.
2. **Web design & Development**: 15+ live deployed web platforms, headless e-commerce, custom web apps, API architecture, and 95+ PageSpeed performance.
3. **Social Media marketing**: Omnichannel strategy, viral short-form video reels, community growth, and Meta Advantage+ paid scaling.
4. **Public relation & Media outreach**: Strategic press release distribution, tier-1 media placements, crisis communications, and executive thought leadership.
5. **Google ads & Intent Scaling**: High-intent Search, Performance Max, YouTube conversion funnels, and granular GA4 multi-touch attribution.
6. **Event activation & Exhibition**: 3D booth design & custom fabrication, B2B trade show installations, corporate galas, and experiential brand activations.
